```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, bayesplot, tidybayes, cmdstanr, here)
source("functions.R")
```


```{r}
#load in the patient and print summary of fitted parameters
patient_id = 04

target_dir = here("data")



```

```{r}
df <- list.files(target_dir, full.names = T) |> 
  map(read_csv) |> 
  bind_rows(.id = "id") |> 
  group_by(id) |> 
  mutate(PSA_norm = PSA / first(PSA))

ggplot(df, aes(x = Days, y =PSA_norm)) +
    geom_path() +
 facet_wrap(~id, scales = "free_y")
       
```
